preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of elements that can be changed must be between 0 and the minimum of 10 or N-2.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: any(a0 + i * d == int(stdout.split()[i]) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The output must form an arithmetic progression with the first element a0 and common difference d.

postconditions.expression: all(a0 + i * d <= a0 + (i+1) * d for i in range(N-1))
postconditions.description: The output must be a valid arithmetic progression with non-decreasing elements.
